statement.text:
(a) Considering all closed, orientable, $\pi_1$-injective surfaces (possibly non-embedded) in all closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds, what is the infimum of the areas of all these surfaces?

(b) One can ask the same question, but considering just closed, orientable, $\pi_1$-injective surfaces of a fixed genus g.

(c) One can also consider only closed, orientable, embedded $\pi_1$-injective surfaces.

(d) Alternatively, one can consider all closed, orientable, essential surfaces in all hyperbolic 3-manifolds M, allowing M not to be closed.
